notes: Public and congressional support now erode over a year or more instead of a month: every bad headline moves opinion about a third as much, Congress follows the public more slowly, and calm months let support settle back. A slow war-weariness sets in during the insurgency
Washington's pressure over the missing WMD starts after about ten months instead of three weeks, and a priority hunt runs for four months

The story is spread across years: the Saudi, Iranian and Syrian decisions, the detainee scandal, the Iraqi security forces, militias and the Awakening now arrive months apart, and the new Iraqi government forms later

Funding cuts are now a conversation. When major combat ends, the Secretary of Defense and the Armed Services Committee ask for your assessment first: present a campaign plan and keep the money (hold more ground within four months), accept a leaner budget, or offer a phased drawdown. Funding restrictions on the conditions ladder are discussed the same way, and you can testify to head them off

Congressional reviews of ground held are quarterly instead of monthly, get-well plans run three months, and the conditions ladder only starts after six months of war with two months to meet each set of conditions
